policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O convenes security leaders ahead of cyber announcement
items.summary: O convened security leaders around an upcoming cyber announcement, following an open letter warning orgs have only months to prepare for AI-enabled cyberattacks.

items.headline: O limits Astra access for “critical” cyber tools
items.summary: O said the Astra model will be released broadly, but its most powerful cyber capabilities will be initially limited to trusted testers pending safeguards.

items.headline: O to restrict Astra’s top cyber capabilities
items.summary: O indicated it’s slowing release and limiting the highest-capability cyber tooling around Astra to add additional safety measures before broader rollout.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A at $3.5B
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A, valuing the company at $3.5B, to accelerate its inference footprint. It reported scaling from 54MW toward 200+MW in 2027.
